facts: Device identity is certificate fingerprint; approved peer access and folder model, not per-note user ACL.
Global/local discovery and public relaying have metadata/privacy consequences and defaults that are unsuitable without explicit configuration.
Receive-encrypted uses folder-scoped encryption and still has beta/testing warning.
Trusted endpoints receive plaintext; this is not read/update/publish authorisation per document.
SOCKS5 supports outbound proxy connections.
Default proxy failure permits direct fallback; ALL_PROXY_NO_FALLBACK=1 is necessary for fail-closed operation.
Plugins inherit application permissions; no reliable per-plugin permission restriction.
Restricted mode disables community plugins; plugin review is not application sandboxing.
Vault files are local plaintext Markdown.
Vault .obsidian configuration is separate from global config and metadata/IndexedDB cache.
Official open URI supports percent-encoded vault/file or path; arbitrary actions must not be accepted from content.
Official Android APK download outside Play is documented.
Do not copy documented no-sandbox AppImage example as a protected-profile security control.
Free personal/commercial/non-profit use does not make application open source.
Application code ownership retained by vendor; redistribution/repackaging cannot be assumed permitted.
Use direct official installation; do not place proprietary app inside AEGIS release without permission.
Internal storage is inaccessible to other ordinary apps; explicit URI grant changes access.
SAF user selects directory tree; Android 11+ restricts Android/data and obb.
Shared tree permissions do not restore ciphertext after an authorised consumer copied plaintext.
Syncthing source licence is MPL 2.0; distributed covered binaries need associated licence/source obligations reviewed.
